title: Choose a delivery meaning
when: Execution-profile confirmation today; when delivery matters in the planned journey
need: Persistent delivery, explicit merge-only and no default are distinct answers. A merge-only item completes through merge close-out and its remaining gates without a release run, even when its checkout has no GitHub remote.
surface: Onboard profile “The delivery box”; hosting posture and default precedence in projects-and-flows.
gap: JOURNEYS row 12 should branch on the recorded answer; absence of environments is not automatically a setup defect. Progressive timing is planned, not current.
review: Source regression covers local first merge and pass-through level changes; installed activation still needs the release campaign proof.
